question: By when has India aimed to achieve its defence production of ₹3 lakh crore, which will strengthen its position as a global defence manufacturing hub?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2029**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• India has set an ambitious goal to achieve a defence production target of **₹3 lakh crore** by the year **2029**. This initiative aims to strengthen India's position as a global defence manufacturing hub.
 
• The target includes achieving **₹1 lakh crore in defence exports**, showcasing India's focus on becoming a major exporter of defence equipment.
 
• As part of this vision, the government is working towards enhancing **self-reliance in defence production**, reducing imports of defence equipment, and promoting domestic manufacturing capabilities.
 
• India’s Ministry of Defence has introduced several policies like the **Defence Production and Export Promotion Policy (DPEPP) 2020** to achieve this goal.
